captionBasis: every printed caption in this map was read from the official form's own content stream at the widget's coordinates; captionReadAt records where, and the build refuses if a caption is no longer there
routeSelectionNote: 15 M.R.S.A. § 2262-A is the route and CR-289 is its form. The only election on it is which court the case is in — Superior Court, District Court or the Unified Criminal Docket — which is a fact about the case rather than a consequence of the route. The form's two substantive assertions are printed in the body of the motion and carry no control at all; signing it asserts them.
